description: This file implements an Elasticsearch aggregation worker for Mattermost, managing job claiming, execution, index management, and cleanup within the Elasticsearch backend.

classes.name: ElasticsearchAggregatorInterfaceImpl
classes.description: Implements the interface to create Elasticsearch aggregator workers.

classes.name: ElasticsearchAggregatorWorker
classes.description: Handles job execution, index management, and cleanup for Elasticsearch aggregation tasks.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Elasticsearch aggregator worker instance.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker, manages job processing loop, and handles shutdown.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on license and configuration.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Claims and processes a job, managing Elasticsearch index reindexing and cleanup.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.
